stories.title: Paras Healthcare sets IPO price band, opens Oct 21
stories.summary: Paras Healthcare announced a price band of Rs 660‑693 per share for its Rs 1,450 crore IPO, which is scheduled to open on October 21. The issue comprises a fresh issuance of Rs 500 crore and an offer‑for‑sale of Rs 950 crore. The company said the proceeds will be used mainly to repay borrowings.
stories.why: The fund‑raising will reduce the firm’s debt load and provides investors with a new equity opportunity in the Indian healthcare sector.

stories.title: ICICI Bank Q2 profit jumps 20% on higher net interest income
stories.summary: ICICI Bank reported a 20% rise in second‑quarter net profit, helped by an 18% increase in core net interest income. Net interest margin fell to 4.18%, and treasury operations posted a loss as higher government‑bond yields reduced returns. Core profitability edged lower because FCNR(B) deposits weighed on margins.
stories.why: The earnings show strong profit growth but also reveal margin pressure, which matters for investors assessing the bank’s near‑term profitability outlook.

stories.summary: India’s primary market is set for a busy week, led by Reliance Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213 crore IPO and Paras Healthcare’s Rs 1,450 crore issue. Nine companies are also scheduled to list, including six on the mainboard and three on SME platforms.

stories.title: Trump suspends upcoming Russia sanctions as tensions with Ukraine rise
stories.summary: President Donald Trump issued an executive order on Friday night to suspend a set of sanctions on Russia that were slated to take effect two days later, drawing criticism from U.S. lawmakers. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the move shows a complete disregard for the sanctions, while Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev called it a historic moment. The suspension follows a U.S. deal to import Russian diesel, further straining Washington‑Kyiv relations.
stories.why: The pause reduces economic pressure on Russia and could alter the dynamics of U.S. support for Ukraine.

stories.previousSummary: Donald Trump blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect, as a row with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky deepens. Zelensky said it was unfortunate the US has decided to "completely disregard" the sanctions.

stories.title: India announces first tariff concessions for New Zealand imports
stories.summary: India will start applying customs‑duty concessions on selected New Zealand products from 20 October under the bilateral free‑trade agreement. The concessions give a zero basic duty on sheep meat and reduced rates on fish and wine, while manuka honey and kiwi fruit will be subject to specific duties. Dairy products are excluded from this first tranche of liberalisation.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.previousTitle: India notifies first tariff cuts under New Zealand FTA
stories.previousSummary: India will apply customs‑duty concessions on selected New Zealand imports from 20 October 2026. The concessions include zero basic duty on sheep meat, set duties on fish and wine, a 15 % duty on kiwi fruit, and unspecified rates for manuka honey. Dairy products remain excluded from the liberalisation.

stories.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio to visit India next week
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to India next week for meetings in Mumbai and Jamnagar that will focus on investment and energy cooperation. The visit is intended to strengthen bilateral relations and address trade issues. Both countries have experienced considerable delays in finalising a broader US‑India trade agreement, which officials attribute to a range of ongoing challenges.
stories.why: The talks are part of efforts to address the delays in the pending US‑India trade agreement.
